verdict.description: Derived from coverage, not chosen independently. `Approve` requires every domain to be `judged` or `clear` -- or, in `build` mode only, `not-in-scope` with a stated reason. Any `degraded`, `detected-only`, or `not-reviewed` domain forces `Inconclusive`, including a clean `core` review that left domains at `detected-only`. `No verdict` only when every lane failed. A schema cannot express this conditional, so the orchestrator enforces it.

verification.description: Every check the lanes ran, carried through verbatim. The report mandates this section, so it cannot be dropped at consolidation.

check.description: The exact command or interaction steps.

coverage.description: Every domain, keyed by name. All six keys are required, so a domain cannot be silently omitted and cannot appear twice.

state.description: judged/clear permit Approve. detected-only, not-reviewed and degraded force Inconclusive. not-in-scope is valid only in build mode and permits Approve, but requires a reason in `result`.

evidence.description: What was actually inspected, or why nothing was.

result.description: Findings count, or the reason for the state. Required non-empty for not-in-scope and not-reviewed.

confirmed.description: Deduped by root cause, ordered by severity then reach. The mode cap (5 quick / 8 core / 15 full) is enforced by the orchestrator after validation; a schema cannot see the mode.

domain.description: Must match a key in `coverage`; the same six-domain vocabulary as the lane schemas.

locations.description: Every path:line sharing this root cause. At least one -- an entry with no location cannot be verified or deduplicated.

degradedCoverage.description: Named lanes that errored or returned unusable output. Required: use null when none did -- strict structured outputs cannot express an omitted key.

mode.description: The mode that produced this report. not-in-scope coverage is only valid when this is build.
